title: Contributing
text: Feedback, bug reports, ideas welcome GitHub issues. workflow : Branch dev, integration branch (one short-lived branch per change). main, default branch, holds latest release. Keep changes small focused. Run package checks locally pushing (see Setup ). Open pull request dev (choose dev base; GitHub offers main default). CI must pass merge. PR dev branch repo merges (squash) CI passes, kept date dev waits; done NCC ConsTech Automation app (.github/workflows/auto-merge.yml update-branches.yml). Open draft hold back. open pull requests main. main changes promotion PR dev, opened owner asks, usually release (ADR 0024).

cover's 1.6 is rounded to 2. layers <- data.frame(   path = rij, prefix = "T_", datatype = "INT1U", subdir = "species" ) output_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "extracted") paths <- extract_layers(   layers, aoi_raster, template,   output_dir = output_dir ) #> Dropped 1 row of /__w/_temp/Library/constechr/extdata/rij.rds with no values in #> the AOI: "sp_b". basename(paths) #> [1] "T_sp_a.tif"  "T_cover.tif" terra::values(terra::rast(paths[["cover"]]), mat = FALSE) #> [1] 0 0 0 0 2 0 0 0 0  # One multi-band file per layer instead, named after the layer's file paths <- extract_layers(   rij, aoi_raster, template,   output_dir = output_dir, datatype = "FLT4S", multiband = TRUE ) #> Dropped 1 row of /__w/_temp/Library/constechr/extdata/rij.rds with no values in #> the AOI: "sp_b". basename(paths) #> [1] "rij.tif"  # A GeoTIFF on the template too (needs prioritizr), with progress if (requireNamespace("prioritizr", quietly = TRUE)) {   x <- extract_layers(     c(template, rij), aoi_raster, template,     progress = function(i, n, layer) {       message("Layer ", i, " of ", n, ": ", basename(layer))     }   )   names(x) } #> Layer 1 of 2: template.tif #> Layer 2 of 2: rij.rds #> Dropped 1 row of /__w/_temp/Library/constechr/extdata/rij.rds with no values in #> the AOI: "sp_b". #> [1] "template" "rij"       # A table whose file paths are in another column, such as NAT_DATA's # catalogue (see read_natdata_metadata()) layers <- data.frame(folder = "species", file = rij, datatype = "INT1U") paths <- extract_layers(   layers, aoi_raster, template,   output_dir = output_dir, path_column = "file" ) #> Dropped 1 row of /__w/_temp/Library/constechr/extdata/rij.rds with no values in #> the AOI: "sp_b". basename(paths) #> [1] "sp_a.tif"  "cover.tif"
